references.text: The tribe of Manasseh is mentioned as one of the tribes of Joseph's sons, with its own leader.
A former representative from the tribe of Manasseh was chosen to spy out the land.
The tribe of Manasseh was allotted land on the east side of the Jordan.
Context for the tribes that were to divide the land, including Manasseh.
Manasseh was adopted by Jacob as one of the tribal fathers, along with Ephraim, as Joseph's sons.
The distribution of land to the tribe of Manasseh under Joshua.
